```{r}
# Import the data
pres_data_path <- "C:/Users/aasie/OneDrive/Documentos/GIS713-Homework3/Data/2016_US_County_Level_Presidential_Results.csv"
acs_county_data_path <- "C:/Users/aasie/OneDrive/Documentos/GIS713-Homework3/Data/acs2015_county_data.csv"

```
```{r}
# Look at column names in the datasets 
colnames(acs_counties)
colnames(election_results)
print(nrow(acs_counties))
print(nrow(election_results))
```

```{r}
# Remove non-CONUS counties from both datasets 
# print(unique(acs_counties$State))
acs_counties <- acs_counties[!State == "Alaska" & 
                            !State == "Hawai'i", 
                            !State == "Puerto Rico"]
election_results <- election_results[!state_abbr == "AK" & 
                                    !state_abbr == "HI" & 
                                    !state_abbr == "PR"]
print(nrow(acs_counties))
print(nrow(election_results))
```
